terra.problem: Saying Jeroboam brought everybody with him adds that he gathered or led them. The text says he and the assembly came to Rehoboam.
The explanation makes speaking kindly the only condition. The elders also advise Rehoboam to be a servant to the people and serve them that day.
It says kind words would make the people his servants forever, omitting the elders' condition that Rehoboam also serve them.
The three days had not necessarily been used up when the young men gave their advice. The people return after the advice is given.
Saying the crowd thinned out but some stayed suggests some of the assembly remained. The text says the Israelites went home and that Rehoboam still reigned over Israelites living in Judah's cities.
The passage does not say that Adoram was stoned in Shechem. Saying all of this happened there supplies a location the text leaves open.
The explanation is generic and mostly repeats that Jeroboam was made king, without much of Papa Dorin's voice.
Saying the warriors are headed for Israel suggests they have set out. The text says Rehoboam mobilized them to fight, but does not say they marched out.
